title: Federated Robot Learning - Enabled by Argon

scenes.headline: Federated Robot Learning
scenes.sub: Enabled by Argon. Every robot failure makes the fleet smarter.
scenes.say: Federated robot learning, enabled by Argon.

scenes.headline: Robot fleets record thousands of hours.
scenes.sub: 8 GB · 788 rides · 50 hours of public robot video
scenes.say: Robot fleets record thousands of hours. Real failures are rare, and engineers don't have time to find them.

scenes.headline: Argon finds the failures that matter.
scenes.say: Argon watches every clip, and keeps only what it can see go wrong.

scenes.headline: Argon rebuilds each failure as a digital twin.
scenes.say: It rebuilds each failure as a digital twin, from a few real frames.

scenes.headline: Then it makes harder what-ifs.
scenes.say: Then it makes harder what-ifs. Someone steps out. A truck runs the light.

scenes.headline: Argon writes the reward for RL.
scenes.sub: Good rides above. Bad rides below.
scenes.say: It writes the reward for reinforcement learning, by watching good rides and bad ones.

scenes.headline: Reinforcement learning trains a better policy.
scenes.sub: Before: hits the pole. After: steers around it.
scenes.say: Reinforcement learning trains on forty variants of the failure.

scenes.headline: Blocked.
scenes.sub: Caught gaming the reward. Rewritten. Trained again.
scenes.say: When it games the reward, parking in front of an obstacle, or launching off a curb, it is caught, and the reward is rewritten.

scenes.headline: Now it doesn't fail.
scenes.sub: Indoors and outdoors. Approved by Argon.
scenes.say: Now it doesn't fail. Indoors and outdoors, in every harder variant. Approved by Argon.

scenes.headline: Now it doesn't fail.
scenes.say: Here is the same fix, rendered photorealistically.

scenes.headline: Checked against every site before it ships.
scenes.say: Before it ships, Argon checks every other site. It blocked a fix that broke another site, until it passed both.

scenes.headline: Federated Robot Learning
scenes.say: Hindsight. Every robot failure makes the fleet smarter.
